page_one.title:
Discover. Design. Build.
Govern. Manage.
page_one.intro: Adapt Cloud applies this method to your AI priorities, combining specialist Claude advisory with hands-on engineering. We work with your team from the initial business case through ongoing governance, operation and improvement.
page_one.band_title: An annual service built around your priorities
page_one.band_body: An initial term of 12 months or longer, renewable by agreement. Monthly working reviews and a rolling 90-day plan guide the advisory and engineering work.

offers.title: A plan for the next 90 days
offers.body: We establish the current position with your business and technical owners. Together, we choose the improvements worth pursuing and revise the plan as evidence and priorities change.

offers.title: Engineering capacity to act on the plan
offers.body: The agreement reserves capacity for approved improvements. Each has a scope, an owner and acceptance tests. Larger changes are scoped separately, with your approval before work begins.

offers.title: A business review of the results
offers.body: Monthly reports cover performance, total cost, completed work and unresolved issues. Quarterly reviews assess whether the benefit justifies further investment and what should change.

page_one.closing: A named Adapt Cloud delivery lead stays accountable throughout the term.

page_two.title: The method in practice.
page_two.accelerator_body: The engagement includes PromptForce.AI from DayTwoAI.com as a platform accelerator for readiness assessment and reusable development components. Adapt Cloud leads the advisory, integration and engineering, and reports on the agreed work.
page_two.accelerator_note: Platform access, usage, support and provider responsibilities are set out in the agreement.

steps.label: 01  DISCOVER
steps.body: Understand the business need, current systems and costs. Establish the baseline and identify work worth pursuing.

steps.label: 02  DESIGN
steps.body: Define the solution, data boundaries, responsibilities and acceptance criteria. Agree the scope and investment.

steps.label: 03  BUILD
steps.body: Implement and integrate the solution. Test its performance and controls, then release it with approval and a rollback plan.

steps.label: 04  GOVERN
steps.body: Apply access, data, cost and change controls throughout the work. Maintain approval records and evidence of compliance with agreed requirements.

steps.label: 05  MANAGE
steps.body: Review performance, resolve issues and plan improvements within the service scope. Feed the findings back into Discover.

page_two.proof_body: Govern applies from discovery onward. Manage maintains the operating review and improvement plan throughout the term. The statement of work defines accountability, capacity, acceptance and remedies for missed commitments.
page_two.renewal: Monthly working reviews and quarterly business reviews guide the next cycle. Renewal follows a review of results and agreement on the next term.
page_two.cta: Discuss your AI priorities with us.
page_two.cta_body: Contact info@adaptcloud.io to discuss your current AI work, the decisions ahead and where specialist support would help.
